fields.postcondition: each PostgreSQL command executes with isolated cloned NpgsqlParameter instances, statement preparation when non-multiplexed, and transient error classification via NpgsqlException.IsTransient
fields.response: return a transient-error predicate evaluating NpgsqlException.IsTransient from GetIsErrorTransient, construct NpgsqlConnection and NpgsqlCommand in NewConnection and NewCommand, and in SetParameters clone each required NpgsqlParameter, apply any per-shard parameterValues overrides (or DBNull.Value when null), throw ParameterNotFoundException when a named query parameter is missing from both collections, and call cmd.Prepare() when NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder(connection.ConnectionString).Multiplexing is false
fields.subject: DataProviderServiceFactory (ArgentSea.Pg)
fields.trigger: PostgreSQL connections, commands, parameters, or retry predicates are requested during command execution
